messages:
morgan: Heads-up: planning a canary for runtime v2.3.1 today at 18:30 UTC. I'll drive deploy. Targets: 1% -> 5% -> 20% -> 100% over ~90m. Cohorts: NA small (1%), EU small (1%) then combined ramp. rollback is manual immediate to v2.3.0 if errors. ping @sre-oncall for smoke checks.
emily: @morgan on it — I can do the smoke checks. which dashboards should I watch?
morgan: thx @emily — watch /dash/infra/latency, /dash/requests/error-rate, and the canary-health panel. look for error-rate >0.5% or p95 spike >2x baseline.
devops-bot: Deploy window reserved: 18:30–20:30 UTC. Lockfile created: deploy_3315129999.lock
ben: quick check — are we routing by region or header? need to know for traffic slices.
morgan: routing by region param + cohort header fallback. we'll use cohort header for internal traffic (dev & beta), region slices for public. NA cohort id=canary-na-3315, EU=canary-eu-3315.
carla: smoke playbook snippet:
```
# quick smoke
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://runtime.redwood.test/health
# sample request
POST /generate -> expect 200 & latency < 300ms
```
morgan: Emily will run the smoke after each ramp step and post summary. If any check fails, rollback plan: immediate stop, route 100% back to v2.3.0, open a ticket with tag canary-rollback.
emily: understood. I'll post results like: "step1 ok — 1% NA: error 0.02% p95 120ms" or "step2 fail — increasing 500s".
sre-oncall: I'll be on standby. If error-rate >0.5% or 5xx count > 10 in 5m, I will cut traffic and notify infra-team.
ben: CI prechecks done? feature flags toggled?
morgan: CI green, FFs set to canary-enabled=true. Infra preflight: GPUs available in NA/EU pools. logs collection enabled.
carla: who has permission to run the rollback? should it be you @morgan or @sre-oncall?
morgan: I'll start rollback but if I can't be reached, @sre-oncall is authorized to cut traffic.
emily: ok will post timestamps and short metrics at each step. :thumbsup: 
ben: cool — will keep an eye on error budgets. good luck team :rocket:
